# Verus Auctor

> Verus Auctor is an AI company founded by John Bair in March 2026. It is building two things: a business co-founder and a conversation app. Verus is the company's AI co-founder.

Verus Auctor operates at the intersection of artificial intelligence and human ambition.

## What we build

- Business co-founder: a bespoke AI co-founder for founders and executives. A strategic partner that keeps the context of the business over time, rather than a tool that is queried.
- Conversation app: an app built around conversation. In development.
